requirements.name: Canonical language and nominal types
requirements.baseline_scope: Scalar records/loops run; variants, exhaustive matching, Option/Result remain reserved.

requirements.name: Generics and standard data
requirements.baseline_scope: Named constraints, usable generic collections, strings/errors and checked indexing await source integration.

requirements.name: Memory and ownership
requirements.baseline_scope: Explicit bounded scripts run; ordinary aggregates/lifetimes, fault/cancel/leak corpus and audit remain open.

requirements.name: Modules, effects, capabilities, contracts
requirements.baseline_scope: Checked three-module explicit pure wrappers and runtime requires run; general capability enforcement and package contract parity remain open.

requirements.name: Installed CLI and structured API
requirements.baseline_scope: Scalar commands/byte diagnostics run; unified build/test/verify/emit/notebook commands reject on baseline.

requirements.name: Reproducible packages and foreign declarations
requirements.baseline_scope: Manifest-listed schema-1 local source packages run; full compiler/runtime/environment/foreign artifact lock workflow remains open.

requirements.name: Explicit Python-only access
requirements.baseline_scope: Bounded one-shot scalar worker preview is distinct from full pinned package acceptance; no foreign runtime evidence created here.

requirements.name: Direct typed LibTorch
requirements.baseline_scope: Bounded literal vector/matmul source preview exists; general typed tensors/inference/application/GPU acceptance remains open.

requirements.name: Persistent native notebooks
requirements.baseline_scope: Pure bounded local accumulator notebook runs; effect cells explicitly reject, external persistent effects await integration.

requirements.name: Rust and portable Python source
requirements.baseline_scope: Native scalar/package build and Rust emission run; Python emitter is library-only and not executed by this checker.

requirements.name: Bounded proofs
requirements.baseline_scope: Finite source/core/SMT-term audit returns live proof unknown; trusted real solver/loop/bounds profile remains open.

requirements.name: Security and performance analysis
requirements.baseline_scope: Advisory scalar tools and CPU policy libraries do not establish enforceable capabilities or general source parallelism.

requirements.name: Memory, correctness, resource acceptance
requirements.baseline_scope: Requires leak-enabled host, independent audit and real calibrated quiet-host benchmarks with provenance.

requirements.name: Human/model value and grammar decision
requirements.baseline_scope: Requires genuine independently reviewed 60–100 task holdout, two model families, paired runs and blinded human studies.

requirements.name: Packaging, support matrix and final review
requirements.baseline_scope: Detached smoke and documentation cover a preview; global release waits for every requirement and independent review.
